newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Uraco tops active, 10 mln shares crossed.
newsitem.headline: Uraco tops active, 10 mln shares crossed.

text.p: Precision engineering firm Uraco Holdings Ltd (UHL) topped the actives in the morning session on the Stock Exchange of Singapore on Wednesday with over 12.8 million shares traded.
Dealers said of the 12.8 million shares traded, a total of 10 million shares were crossed. Five million shares were crossed at Singapore $0.88 and another five million at S$0.90.
Uraco shares were up S$0.025 at S$0.91 after hitting a morning high of S$0.95.
Dealers said the strong U.S. November book-to-bill ratio for semiconductors continued to buoy selected electronic counters in Singapore, including Uraco.

On Monday, the U.S. semiconductor Industry Association said its book-to-bill ratio rose to 1.15 in November from a revised 1.11 in October. Market expectations were for the index to be flat to slightly firmer against October.
